subject: Fuel tank connection hose (supersedes 2020-14-06)

subject: Nose landing gear leg
detail: Was terminated per MSB 40-046 (2012); superseded by 2024-19-08

subject: Passenger door latching & safety hook (supersedes NPRM FAA-2026-4633)
detail: Eff 07-Dec-2026. Insert AFM TR-MAM-40-1203 (owner may do; log per 43.9(a)/91.417(a)(2)(v)) and do the initial door inspection, handle-force check and placards per WI-MSB 40-103 Rev 2 — within 100 hr TIS or 100 days after the effective date (17-Mar-2027, calculated), whichever first. Gas spring: 100-hr re-checks until replaced within 12 months, or replace before further flight, depending on force readings. Credit for earlier MSB 40-103 Rev 0/1 work. FAA calls it interim. Requirements from the NPRM text; final rule not read in full.

subject: Fuel injector lines & clamps
detail: Every 100 hr (≤110). Last 02-Mar-2026 @ 3140.3; on 03-Nov-2026 work order

subject: Connecting rod bushings (supersedes 2024-21-02)
